tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_appointments AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.contact_id, src.host_user_id, src.host_name, src.source, src.status, src.title, src.starts_at, src.ends_at, src.provider, src.created_at FROM (
SELECT 
  ap.id,
  ap.organization_id,
  ap.contact_id,
  ap.host_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS host_name,
  ap.source,
  ap.status,
  ap.title,
  ap.starts_at,
  ap.ends_at,
  ap.provider,
  ap.created_at
FROM crm.appointments ap
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = ap.host_user_id
WHERE ap.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS scheduled_appointments, CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'completed') AS BIGINT) AS completed_appointments, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST((CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'completed') AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL)) * 100.0 AS DECIMAL), 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS meeting_completion_rate FROM rpt_appointments AS appointments WHERE TRUE AND starts_at >= %(start)s AND starts_at < %(end)s AND TRUE LIMIT 500
